raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Agent details Prepared with AI assistance. Model-owned physical replicas need synchronization after initialization/loading and gradient combination before clipping. Three private no-op hooks expose only those lifecycle boundaries and logical norm selection. Count logical parameters once while clipping every physical copy, preserving the ordinary optimizer path. ## Test Plan ```bash python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/cpu/components/optim/test_optim.py tests/unit_tests/cpu/test_trainer.py -q -k 'not graph_training' ``` --- Stack created with GitHub Stacks CLI • Give Feedback 💬

+def test_logical_norm_counts_one_copy_but_clips_both() -> None:
+    canonical = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(2))
+    replica = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(2))
+    canonical.grad = torch.tensor([3.0, 4.0])
+    replica.grad = canonical.grad.clone()
+
+    norm = clip_grad_norm_(
+        [canonical, replica], 1.0, norm_parameters=[canonical], foreach=True
+    )
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(norm, torch.tensor(5.0))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(canonical.grad, torch.tensor([0.6, 0.8]))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(replica.grad, canonical.grad)
